data: For which Monte Carlo search method is the computation time per game step measured for 100, 200, and 500 roll-outs?

The caption states that for each MonteCarlo search method, win rate and computation time were measured for 100, 200, and 500 roll-outs per game step, respectively. The figure shows three different lines representing Full model, Latent variable, and Game only methods. Each line has points corresponding to 100, 200, and 500 roll-outs. Therefore, the computation time per game step is measured for all three Monte Carlo search methods.
